cosmin.look: Cosmin, a fourteen-year-old cooper's boy from Vallaki, thin and a full head shorter than a grown man, with short messy dark-brown hair, a smudged freckled boy's face with a stubborn chin, wearing a patched oatmeal-coloured wool jacket with rolled sleeves over a brown shirt, worn brown breeches and scuffed boots, a heavy grey-brown horse blanket rolled over one shoulder and tied across his chest with rope, and a crude wooden sword (a carved plank with a crosspiece) held in his right hand
cosmin.who: Cosmin, a fourteen-year-old cooper's boy with a horse blanket rolled over his shoulder and a wooden sword
cosmin.windup: the wooden sword raised high over his right shoulder in both hands, a fierce stubborn face, blanket swinging
cosmin.strike: the wooden sword swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow
